title: Thu 12 Nov · morning check
summary:
[b]Overnight:[/b] the dollar hit a 19-month high on December hike bets (~91%), Tokyo warned again about fast yen moves, French bond stress eased to 142.4bp and oil slipped on peace-talk hopes.
[b]Today:[/b] UK Q3 GDP 09:00 Bucharest · US jobless claims 15:30 (time not verified) · US EIA oil stocks.

USD.note: December hike priced 87–91%, ~13% for 50bp. No bearish invalidation met.

EUR.note: OAT–Bund spread down to 142.4bp from 161.8bp; still above the ~130bp line, Senate votes ahead.

GBP.note: No new item; UK Q3 GDP 09:00 Bucharest is the test.

JPY.note: Mimura warning refreshes the intervention shield; no fresh BoJ December pricing (last 70–75%).

CHF.note: No new SNB item; calmer risk mood is the watch.

CAD.note: Oil lower again, API crude build; supports the bearish case.

AUD.note: Inflation expectations unchanged at 5.3%; no RBA item.

NZD.note: No new item; dairy auction 17 Nov.

XAU.status: INVALIDATED by written rule (model still bullish)
XAU.note: Gold own score +7 or +4 if real yields keep rising; XAU +14 or +11.
